newsitem.title: UK: C&W in talks with Nynex on cable link - paper.
newsitem.headline: C&W in talks with Nynex on cable link - paper.

text.p: Cable and Wireless Plc is in talks with NYNEX Corp on an alliance involving the U.S. company taking a stake in C&W's planned $500 million transatlantic cable link, the Financial Times said on Thursday.
The report comes after C&W on Wednesday told Reuters that it was negotating with NYNEX and other telecoms firms about possible new ventures.

The Financial Times said that under the proposed deal C&W would gain greater access to the international traffic generated by the U.S. multinational companies based in NYNEX's home region around New York.

NYNEX would acquire a 10 to 20 percent stake in the joint venture between C&W and MFS Communications, the U.S.-based busienss telecoms group, for a fibre-optic cable between Britain and the U.S., the newspaper added.
C&W already plans to merge its UK Mercury unit with NYNEX CableComms Group and two other cable operators.
